name: NOWPayments – beCrypto Gateway for WooCommerce
author: sipho213

sections.description:
Accept cryptocurrency payments in your WooCommerce store using NOWPayments, a powerful and easy-to-use crypto gateway.

Supports over 100 cryptocurrencies including BTC, ETH, and stablecoins. Seamless integration with WooCommerce, quick setup, and secure payments.

  1. Upload the plugin ZIP via WordPress admin or extract it to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Configure NOWPayments settings in WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > NOWPayments.

Coming Soon

🚀 Nowpayments Pro – More features, better customization, enhanced reporting!
sections.faq:
Do I need a NOWPayments account?

Yes. You can create one here: https://account.nowpayments.io/create-account?link_id=3734457755

What cryptocurrencies are supported?

Over 100+ including BTC, ETH, LTC, DOGE, BNB, SHIB, and many more.

Is there a sandbox mode?

Currently no. A test mode option will be added in a future release.
